label: end-of-episode / low-value unit (GO and D2 of the last ~10 trials)
explanation: Fires only in the final trials of an episode: 99% of activation mass is in ep_trial 90-99 and none before trial 80; equivalently 99.9% of mass is on steps where the value head is in its lowest bin (<5.22), since value falls as the episode end approaches. It fires mostly at GO (55% of mass) and D2 (41%), and rarely at D1. The predicate value < 4 at GO/D2 gives dev F1 0.76 with mass recall 0.90; ep_trial >= 90 alone has mass recall 0.99 but precision 0.30. What modulates magnitude: the strongest activations are on a2 choices (79% of mass falls on trials where the choice is a2; the top windows are all a2 in high_first episodes with S2 good), on unrewarded D1 inputs, and on the very last trials. It is suppressed by a reward input (rate 0.3x) and at D1. Penalty inputs and D1 fixation errors also activate it strongly but are rare. No future variables are needed: value and the upcoming choice of the agent can both be computed by the agent.
